Hello again gate crew,
The ramp coordinator sent an update on pet comfort

I need everyone to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk loop tight on the next pet moves. We have a few anxious handoffs building up, and the main thing is to keep carriers steady, voices low, and the checks consistent so the animals do not get rattled. Please watch for any sign of stress, especially with pets that are not used to loud spaces or quick turns.

For the transfer notes, <<FACT F106>> and make sure the handoff stays clean from the desk to the ramp side. If a traveler looks unsure, use the usual calm script and keep the carrier in view the whole time. Also, <<FACT F092>> so nobody is chasing late paperwork at the counter.

If anything looks off during handling, log it fast and pass it up without delay. <<FACT F102>> We have to keep the records clear, because even a small incident can turn into a bigger problem if it is not tracked right away. Keep the notes short, factual, and easy to follow, and please flag any pet that needs extra space, water, or a slower walk-through before boarding.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
